The latter state is the proper state of the man's spirit... and therefore after death the man remains such as is his second state, because this state is the state of his life; but the former state is not proper to the man, because this state is only a state of thought from the memory... LJPost 35. AE 114:5. AE 114:6.
A spiritual state relatively to a natural state, Explained.
When they receded... malignant Spirits and others succeeded, for the reason that this state of affection was changed...
On changes of state; and that the Angels must be in good and truth in every state.
Hence it was evident, how, when man resists evil and falsity only a little, he can be in a state opposite to them, and in delight.
Such an interior state. Signified, Explained.
By state is meant a state of affection and the derivative thought.
As all times in the Word = states of life; when the Lord is treated of they = infinite state; and infinite state as to time is eternity.
A state of interior life unknown to all except those who are in it. Signified, Explained.
Ignorance of the time (when man is to die), and of the state then, (that it will continue to eternity). Signified, Explained. AE 194:3.
Hour = state; because all times in the Word = states of life. Illustrated.

There are two states of faith and of the derivative life, or of life and the derivative faith, of the men who are in the Church; one is from doctrine, and the other is from the Word, or preaching from the Word... With some, these two states act as a one, and with many they do not. Explained.
The quality of the state of thought, faith, and life from doctrine. Explained.
The state of faith and the derivative life of the men of the Church from the Word. Explained... All within the Church who are saved are kept by the Lord in this state of thought and faith...
Manifestation of the states of those who are of the Church where the Word is. Signified, Explained.
That no one except the Lord knew these states. References.
Influx from the Heavens, and consequent changes of state, and separations. Signified, Explained.
An earthquake = changes of the state of the Church. Explained.
Continually in the state. Signified, Explained.
Instead of the apparent revolutions of our sun, there are merely changes of state, in Angels and Spirits, according to their reception of the good of love and the truth of faith.

That the Divine truth inflows in both states, namely, while the man of the Church is in his spiritual state, and in his natural state. Signified. For the man of the Church is by turns in a spiritual state and in a natural state.
A notable change of the state of the interiors with those who are of the Church. Signified, Explained.
Fear, terror, consternation, and the like, = various... changes of the state of the mind.
The state of the Church: that meanwhile it [the state] may be provided with many. Signified, Explained.
That all activities are changes of state, and variations of form; and that the latter are from the former. By state in man we mean his love, and by changes of state, the affections of love.

For (all things there) come forth according to the states of the Angels, and are permanent according thereto, so that the states themselves, and those things, make a one, and therefore they are also varied just as their states are varied. But this is the case especially in the World of Spirits... because there every man undergoes changes of state... But Spirits do not reflect upon these changes and variations. Explained.

By states are meant states of love and wisdom, or of affections and the derivative thoughts, which are manifold and various. According to these the angelic Societies are distant from each other, and the Heavens from the Hells, and the Societies of the Hells from each other. It has been granted me to see how likeness of state conjoins, and contracts the extension of space or distance; and how unlikeness of state separates, and produces extension of space, or distance. Those there who appear to be a mile apart can instantly be present with each other when the love of the one for the other is excited; and on the other hand those who are talking together can instantly become a mile apart when hatred is excited.
But the idea of state, and the derivative idea of the appearance of space and time (with the Angels) exist solely in the ultimates of creation there, and from them. (Continued. See Space.)
I was then in an interior natural state. Described.
For an Angel does not change his state, that is, pass from a spiritual state into a natural one.
On the first state of man after death. (Fully quoted see Novitiate.)
